definitions.gloss: independent production; self-produced work; indie production
definitions.explanation: Creative work produced independently, without backing from a major studio, label, or publisher. Covers films, music, games, and other media made with personal or small-scale resources.

examples.japanese: {自主制作|じしゅせいさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自主制作|じしゅせいさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He sells his self-produced album online.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{自主制作|じしゅせいさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{短編映画|たんぺんえいが}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{映画祭|えいがさい}→映画祭：30642_eigasai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入選|にゅうせん}→入選：11686_nyuusen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧で、⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Getting selected at a film festival with an indie short film I made in college led me to pursue a professional career.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{自主|じしゅ}→自主：13979_jishu⟧ (independent, autonomous) and ⟦{制作|せいさく}→制作：04320_seisaku⟧ (production, creation). Used across creative fields — film, music, animation, games — to distinguish works made independently from those backed by major companies. Often abbreviated in compound forms as {自主制作|じしゅせいさく}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ (indie film), {自主制作|じしゅせいさく}⟦{盤|ばん}→盤：18576_ban⟧ (indie release).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自主制作|じしゅせいさく}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧: independent film
- {自主制作|じしゅせいさく}⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧: indie animation
- {自主制作|じしゅせいさく}⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧: indie game

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦インディーズ→インディーズ：20028_indiizu⟧: indies — the loanword equivalent, especially common in music (⟦インディーズ→インディーズ：20028_indiizu⟧⟦バンド→バンド：05508_bando⟧)
- ⟦{同人|どうじん}→同人：20053_doujin⟧: doujin — self-published fan works or original creations, typically in manga and game communities
- ⟦{自費出版|じひしゅっぱん}→自費出版：23968_jihishuppan⟧: self-publishing — specifically for books, where the author funds the printing
